package.description: Birthday greetings hybrid unattended automation generated from full export document.

workflows.name: Main
workflows.description: Primary birthday greetings orchestration entry point.

steps.notes: Seed entry workflow so local build has an explicit main workflow.

processNodes.name: Daily 8:00 AM Trigger
processNodes.description: Time trigger starts unattended daily run at 08:00 AM.

processNodes.name: Fetch Today's Events from Birthdays Calendar
processNodes.description: Read today's birthday events from the Birthdays calendar using Google Calendar Integration Service connector.

processNodes.name: Any Birthdays Today?
processNodes.description: Check whether the calendar query returned any birthday events for today.

processNodes.name: Build Birthday Recipient Worklist
processNodes.description: Prepare the list of recipients for the current run and initialize run-level tracking.

processNodes.name: Complete Run (No Birthdays)
processNodes.description: Complete the run with zero birthdays found.

processNodes.name: Create Queue Items (One per Person)
processNodes.description: Create one queue item per birthday person in BirthdayGreetingsV9_Queue using reference format YYYYMMDD_FullName.

processNodes.name: Get Next Person from Queue
processNodes.description: Consume the next transaction item from BirthdayGreetingsV9_Queue.

processNodes.name: Lookup Contact in Google Contacts
processNodes.description: Search Google Contacts by full name to find available email addresses.

processNodes.name: Email Found?
processNodes.description: Determine whether any Personal or Home email address was found for the contact.

processNodes.name: Select Preferred Email (Personal > Home)
processNodes.description: Apply the business rule to prefer Personal email over Home email when multiple addresses exist.

processNodes.name: Skip This Person (No Email Found)
processNodes.description: Skip the transaction with business exception NoEmailFound and persist the audit outcome.

processNodes.name: Generate Personalized Birthday Message
processNodes.description: Generate a warm, funny, lightly sarcastic birthday email subject and body using UiPath GenAI Activities with JSON output.

processNodes.name: Message Quality/Safety OK?
processNodes.description: Validate output schema, guardrails, name inclusion, and max character count from BGV9_MaxMessageChars.

processNodes.name: Send Birthday Email
processNodes.description: Send the approved birthday message through Gmail Integration Service connection ninemush@gmail.com.

processNodes.name: Create Action Center Review Task
processNodes.description: Create Action Center review task when message quality or safety validation fails and human review is enabled.

processNodes.name: Persist Run and Message Audit
processNodes.description: Write run summary and per-recipient results to Data Service entities BirthdayGreetingRun and BirthdayGreetingMessage.

processNodes.name: Complete Sent Outcome
processNodes.description: Complete successful sent transaction and persist final sent status.

processNodes.name: Complete Pending Review Outcome
processNodes.description: Complete transaction as pending review for Action Center follow-up.

processNodes.name: Complete Skipped Outcome
processNodes.description: Complete transaction as skipped due to missing email.

queues.name: BirthdayGreetingsV9_Queue
queues.description: Work queue driving per-person birthday greeting transactions.

assets.name: BGV9_MaxMessageChars
assets.description: Maximum allowed character length for generated body.

storageBuckets.name: birthday-greetings-v9
storageBuckets.description: Stores prompt templates and run artifacts.

agents.description: BGV9_MessageComposerAgent for guarded birthday message generation.
guardrails: Output JSON with subject and body only
